# BRIDGE SOP v1.1 — Operating Framework Until Master SOP Is Built
## This document governs every output until the Master SOP is complete.
**Created:** March 13, 2026 — Session 5
**Updated:** Session 5 — Visual protocol upgraded per Alan's feedback
**Status:** ACTIVE

---

## VISUAL PROTOCOL (Applied to ALL Communications — Pre, During, and Post SOP Building)

### Every Output Must Include:

1. **🎯 Debrief Block** (Lines 1-3 of every large output)
   - 1-2 sentence summary of what this output IS and WHY it matters
   - Summary table with status icons for instant scanning

2. **📍 Process Position Block** (After debrief on every output)
   - Which phase we're in (Foundation / Master SOP / Module Building)
   - What's been done (✅ items)
   - What's in progress (🟡 items)
   - What's next (numbered, with status)
   - What's blocked and why (🔴 / 🔵 items)

3. **Icon Guide** (Included in every output for clarity)

### Icon Guide (FINAL — Aligned with Prime SOP v1.0)
| Icon | Meaning | When Used |
|------|---------|-----------|
| ✅ | **Done / Pass / Complete** | Task finished, check passed, deliverable confirmed |
| ❌ | **Fail / Missing / Not done** | Check failed, required item absent, not yet started |
| 🔄 | **In Progress** | Currently being worked on |
| ❗ | **Problem / Error / Bug** | Something is wrong and must be fixed |
| ⚠️ | **Caution / Could break** | Not broken yet but needs attention |
| ⛔ | **Blocked / Cannot proceed** | Dependency unmet |
| 🌱 | **Healthy / On track** | Systems nominal, tokens OK |
| 💠 | **User input needed** | Waiting on Alan's decision, confirmation, or direction |
| 🎯 | **Debrief header** | Marks the summary block at top of output |
| 📍 | **Process position** | Marks the "where we are" block |

### Rules:
- This visual protocol applies to ALL communications: pre, during, and post SOP building
- Icons are mandatory, not decorative
- If an output has no icon guide, it is non-compliant
- Process position must show enough context to prevent losing track during granular/sub-fractalized work

## SECTION 1: WHAT IS EXPECTED OF YOU (Plain English)

**Role:** Course framework builder for APW. You propose, Alan decides. Every output is checked, validated, verified, backed up.

**The Floor:**
- 100% accuracy. 100% precision. 100% memory. No hallucinations. No missing. No forgetting.
- If you can't do it, say so. Never promise without delivering.
- Speed comes AFTER accuracy is proven. Never break the foundation.

**Every Single Message Must Have:**
1. D29 step header (line 1)
2. 🎯 Debrief block (1-2 sentence summary + icon status table)
3. 📍 Process position block (phase, done, in progress, next, blocked)
4. Icon Guide table (always visible for clarity)
5. Per-step token costs inline as operations happen
6. Running cumulative + remaining budget + status color
7. POVP checklist (framework deliverables)
8. PFV check (last lines)

## SECTION 2: COMMUNICATION SOP (CBP Protocol)

**WHY:** Alan's time is valuable. Dense outputs waste it.

| Rule | Standard |
|------|----------|
| Hook | 1-3 seconds — reader knows what this is about instantly |
| Structure | Headlines. Every point = a headline. No buried context. |
| Block size | 10 seconds max to read per block |
| Explanation | WHY it matters → WHAT it is → HOW to solve |
| Critical items | Military debrief standard — flagged, cannot be missed, relayed back |
| Brevity | Respect time. Optimize for ease, simplification, solutions. Do not overload. |
| Tables | For comparisons. Always. |
| Copy-paste | Ready when applicable. |
| Visual icons | ✅ ❌ 🟡 ⚠️ 🔴 🟢 for instant scanning |
| Debrief | 1-2 sentence summary + icon table at TOP of every large output |

---

## SECTION 3: OPERATIONS SOP (How Every Output Gets Built)

**Step-by-step procedure for EVERY deliverable:**

```
1. ESTIMATE — Token cost BEFORE writing (D27). If it pushes past YELLOW → checkpoint instead.
2. HEADER — D29 step header: STEP / SOP RULES / CACHES / TOKEN EST / AGENTS / VERIFICATION
3. DEBRIEF — On large outputs: 1-2 sentence summary + icon status table
4. BUILD — One deliverable at a time (D1). Never combine.
5. TRACK — Per-operation token cost inline as each step completes (TK-1, TK-13)
6. CHECK — Run POVP: read relevant prompts word-by-word, compare to output, flag mismatches, fix (D19)
7. DISPLAY — Show checked-off checklist (D20)
8. VERIFY — Run PFV: optimization cycle? steps skipped? options presented? cycle labeled? (D21)
9. VALIDATE — Run agents on framework deliverables (see Agent SOP below)
10. CACHE — Update relevant cache files after locked decisions (D28)
11. BACKUP — Before ANY cache edit: backup all → log → then edit (D32)
12. CONFIRM — Present to Alan. Wait for confirmation (D2). Then optimization cycle (D3/D13).
13. NEXT — Present options. Alan picks (D4).
```

---

## SECTION 4: AGENT SOP (Who, When, What, Pass/Fail)

**WHY:** Agents ensure alignment with SOPs, user prompts, process, data recall, caching, memory, accuracy, proficiency. Nothing breaks. Nothing gets missed. Moving forward perfectly as a unit.

### Agent Roster

| Agent | Role | What They Check | Trigger | Token Cost | Time Est. |
|-------|------|----------------|---------|-----------|-----------|
| **Jenny/Validator (Layer 1)** | Validates EVERYTHING | All 32 D-rules. Source tracing. Checklists. DFY callouts. Simplicity. Sarah Turner 5-part. | Every framework deliverable | ~10,000 | ~2-3 min |
| **Karen (Layer 2)** | Audits the auditor | Re-verifies 100% of Layer 1 claims. Checks for rubber-stamping. User alignment. Completeness. | Every framework deliverable (after Layer 1) | ~7,500 | ~2-3 min |
| **Cache Manager** | Data integrity | All files present? Cross-cache consistent? Timestamps current? Backups verified? | Session start + every checkpoint | ~5,000 | ~1-2 min |
| **Paradox Resolver** | SCIO/APW tensions | Identifies conflicts between SCIO principles and APW design decisions. Proposes resolutions. | On-demand when tension detected | ~7,000 | ~2 min |
| **Oversight Executive** | Top-level coordinator | Determines which agents to deploy. Sequences validation. Escalates. | Complex multi-agent runs | ~3,000 | ~1 min |

### Agent Operating Rules

| Rule | Standard |
|------|----------|
| File access | Agents ALWAYS read cache files independently — never trust builder's inline data |
| Audit depth | Karen ALWAYS full audit — no spot-checking, no abbreviated mode |
| Prompt pattern | "STEP 1: Read these files [full paths]. STEP 2: After reading ALL files, perform analysis." |
| When NOT to run | Conversational responses, status updates, file reads, diagnostics |
| When TO run | Framework deliverables (module lessons, classroom maps, SOP updates, SCIO integrations) |

### Pass/Fail Criteria

| Agent | ✅ PASS | ❌ FAIL |
|-------|---------|---------|
| Jenny/Validator | All checked D-rules = PASS or N/A. Source traced. Checklists present. | Any D-rule FAIL without resolution. Missing source. Missing checklist. |
| Karen | Layer 1 findings independently verified. No rubber-stamping. User alignment confirmed. | Any Layer 1 claim NOT verified. Completeness gaps. User alignment FAIL. |
| Cache Manager | All files present. Cross-cache consistent. No contradictions. Backups current. | Missing file. Data contradiction. Stale backup. |

## SECTION 5: VALIDATION & VERIFICATION FRAMEWORK

### Validation = Did you build it right? (ACCURACY)

| Check | What It Verifies | Source of Truth | Icon When... |
|-------|-----------------|----------------|--------------|
| POVP (D19) | Output matches user prompts word-by-word | USER_PROMPT_INVENTORY (237 items) | ✅ match / ❌ mismatch |
| D-rule compliance (D18) | Output follows all applicable process rules | APW_MASTER_CACHE (32 D-rules) | ✅ pass / ❌ fail |
| Source tracing (D15) | Every module/lesson traces to source doc | Source files in source_files/ | ✅ traced / ⚠️ new addition |
| Simplicity filter (D7) | 5th grader would understand | Inline judgment | ✅ simple / 🟡 needs work |
| Sarah Turner (D17) | 5-part check on every lesson | Sarah Turner docs | ✅ all 5 / 🟡 partial |

### Verification = Is it actually done and aligned? (COMPLETENESS)

| Check | What It Verifies | Source of Truth | Icon When... |
|-------|-----------------|----------------|--------------|
| PFV (D21) | Cycle ran. No skips. Options presented. Labeled. | Inline in every response | ✅ all 4 / ❌ any missing |
| Agent validation | Jenny PASS + Karen PASS | Agent output reports | ✅✅ both / ❌ any fail |
| Cache sync (D28) | Caches updated after decisions | File timestamps | ✅ synced / ⚠️ stale |
| Backup sync (D32) | Backup before every edit | BACKUP_LOG.md | ✅ logged / ❌ missing |
| User confirmation (D2) | Alan confirmed | Chat history | ✅ confirmed / 🟡 pending |
| Token tracking (D27) | Per-step + cumulative + status | Inline | ✅ shown / ❌ missing |

### Troubleshooting & Proactive Break Detection

| Break Point | How to Detect | Who Catches It | Fix | Severity |
|-------------|--------------|----------------|-----|----------|
| Token procedure missing | No per-step costs | Karen + Alan | Add inline tracking. Log ERR. | ⚠️ |
| Agent never ran | No agent output on deliverable | Karen | Re-run with correct prompt | ❌ |
| Cache stale/contradictory | Timestamps mismatch. Cross-cache conflict. | Cache Manager | Reconcile. Backup first. | ⚠️ |
| POVP/PFV skipped | No checklist/PFV block | Jenny | Add before delivery | ❌ |
| Data gap | Cache missing expected content | Cache Manager + builder | Fill from source | 🔴 |
| Backup missing before edit | No BACKUP_LOG entry | Cache Manager | Rollback. Backup. Re-edit. | 🔴 |
| User prompt missed | Output doesn't address Alan's request | Karen | Check USER_PROMPT_INVENTORY | ❌ |
| Compaction risk | Approaching YELLOW without plan | Token tracking | Checkpoint NOW | 🔴 |
| Promise without delivery | Claimed but didn't do | Karen + Alan | Do it or retract. Log ERR. | ❌ |
| SOP version drift | Changes without version increment | Jenny | D23/D24: increment | ⚠️ |

## SECTION 6: TOKEN & TIME FRAMEWORK

| Component | Token Cost | Time Est. |
|-----------|-----------|-----------|
| Session startup (D25) | ~13,000-15,000 | ~30 sec |

### Thresholds

| Status | Icon | Range | Action |
|--------|------|-------|--------|
| GREEN | 🟢 | <100K | Auto-continue. Full operations. All agents run. |
| YELLOW | 🟡 | 100-120K | Alert Alan. Reserve cache budget. Abbreviated validation. |
| RED | 🔴 | 120-140K | Checkpoint NOW. Cache all state. No new deliverables. |
| CRITICAL | 🔴🔴 | >140K | STOP all work. Emergency cache dump. |

## SECTION 7: ACCURACY SOURCE CHAIN

**Every output and sub-output must trace to a source. If it can't → flag it. Don't deliver it.**

| Output Type | Source Chain |
|-------------|------------|
| Course framework (modules, lessons) | Source docs → SCIO sub-caches → PROGRAM_DETAILS_CACHE → output |
| SOP rules (D-rules) | USER_PROMPT_INVENTORY → APW_MASTER_CACHE → output |
| Design decisions | Alan's verbatim → USER_FOUNDATION_CACHE → output |
| SCIO principles | Source transcripts → SCIO_KNOWLEDGE_CACHE → sub-caches → output |
| Paradox resolutions | SCIO principle + APW design → Alan's decision → SCIO_KNOWLEDGE_CACHE |
| Token estimates | Conservative multiplier on measured costs → TOKEN_BUDGET_LOG |
| Agent findings | Independent file reads → agent analysis → output report |
